parameters.content:
## master : setup

1. Copy `user_config` into `global_variables`.
2. Probe Gmail, GitHub, Telegram, Supabase, Jina, and n8n (continue on error).
3. Telegram the report. GitHub 204 or 404 both count as working. Star check is always hellovamsi/sorted_signals.
4. If every probe works, import missing workflows from https://github.com/hellovamsi/sorted_signals (`workflows/`). Per-file create/skip is a same-canvas sub-run (like backup : github). If any probe fails, skip import.

Does not overwrite workflows, import credentials, or import data tables. Backup export still uses `backup_gh_*`.

parameters.jsCode:
const cfg=$('Attach repo config').first().json;
return[{json:{...cfg,repo_owner:'hellovamsi',repo_name:'sorted_signals',repo_path:'workflows/',repo_branch:'main'}}];

parameters.content:
## Import loop (main path)
List GitHub files → call this same workflow once per file → tally create/skip/fail.
Caller is Execute Workflow v1.3 (`={{ $workflow.id }}`, mode each, wait, continue on error).

## Sub-run: one GitHub file
Trigger is Execute Workflow Trigger v1.2, Accept all data.
Item already has repo_* plus existingNames / existingIds from the parent (this path cannot see Check n8n).
Get file → large-file fallback → parse → create or skip → return action.
